title: Archived program marker v1
description: docs/programs/<program>/archived.json (D-314, D-324): marks a program folder as archived history so its unmerged items leave the active WORK queue while its plan and retrospective remain readable in the tree.

archived_by.description: The decision under which the program was archived.

archived_at.description: ISO date when the program was marked archived.

reason.description: Why the program is archived rather than active in the live flow.
